newsitem.title: UK: GKN stunned by $400 mln U.S. court award.
newsitem.headline: GKN stunned by $400 mln U.S. court award.

text.p: British-based auto components and defence group GKN Plc said on Thursday an initial jury verdict in a U.S court on a class action claim made by a group of its franchisees had awarded them $398 million in damages -- a sum that could be raised or reduced on further judgement.

"We are extremely surprised at the outcome which we believe to be wholly unreasonable and will appeal following delivery of the judgement," GKN said in a statement, adding it would make an appropriate provision as a charge in its 1996 accounts "on further consideration of all the issues".
"While this judgement represents a setback in the group's financial position it will have no effect on the board's decision in respect of the 1996 dividend," GKN added.
The company's shares fell sharply in busy trading after the announcement, however, and by 1020 GMT were just below 10.00 stg, compared with their Wednesday close of 10.45 stg.

"The judgement in the case will not be issued until post-verdict issues and procedures have been resolved and this could take some weeks. The issues still to be determined could result in a substantial modification of the award," GKN added.
It said that, based on current calculations, it estimated the maximum award would be about $554 million.

The action had been brought in Charlotte, North Carolina, against a unit of GKN's Meineke Discount Muffler Shops, Inc and is based on franchisees' allegations, including breach of contract, in respect of advertising of Meineke.
